authority.programIdentityNote: The 67 MP IDs are canonical identities from META-TRACKER, not PM-invented numbering. The 67-program map is an evolving top-level assessment across the whole program, not a claim of completeness: PM neither renumbers it, completes it, ranks it, nor treats its sequence as a plan. PM manages the five selected identities below; nothing else.
whatPMMayDecide: implementation mechanics of the PM machinery itself (data format, rendering, validation, linking to the ratchet)
how deep to decompose a phase inside an already-selected program
whatPMMayNotDecide: adding or removing a program from PM scope
setting product, MVP or release priority
reinterpreting the final vision or canonical program meaning
autonomous scheduling or activation of programs
converting a planning observation into project authority
authority.expansionRule: The managed set changes only by explicit owner instruction recorded in this file. No PM code, ranking, score or suggestion may change it.

outsideScope.rule: The other 62 meta programs stay canonical in META-TRACKER and may appear in PM output ONLY as external references or dependencies. They must never be materialized as PM-managed programs (no dossier, phases, gates, estimates or tasks).
outsideScope.validation: pm:check FAILS if the decomposition seed contains a program that is not listed here.

canonicalSources.executionAndProof: omega-baseline/experimental/ratchet/ (external owner of atomic execution/proof state)
